# H-Mode

Hemanth's full coding-efficiency suite includes four skills: h-mode,
h-mode-audit, h-mode-review, and h-mode-help. Audit and review are read-only.
Integrations include Claude Code and Codex plugin manifests, a Gemini extension
with four commands, and Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Kiro, and Copilot rule files.

Claude Code hooks provide session activation, mode tracking, and optional
tool-output compression. Compression is lossy, uses an allowlist, and excludes
Read/Edit/Write by default. Support for replacing tool output depends on the
host's response schema. No fresh H-Mode token reduction is claimed.

All committed numerical benchmarks and sample comparisons are historical
upstream results, not H-Mode measurements or guarantees. Their raw files and
provenance are retained unchanged. Live benchmarks are opt-in paid operations;
the replay utility analyzes local transcripts without model calls.

Install from GitHub: npx github:hemanth-create/H-Mode --dry-run
Claude plugin: claude plugin marketplace add hemanth-create/H-Mode
Then: claude plugin install h-mode@h-mode
Codex skills: npx github:hemanth-create/H-Mode --only codex
No npm package publication is claimed. The installer requires Node >= 18.

The compressor makes no network/model calls. The session-start update notice
can query GitHub releases; H_MODE_UPDATE_CHECK=0 disables it.
H_MODE_COMPRESS=0 disables compression. /h-mode off disables the Claude mode.
